description: Fires when a user successfully creates a new account via email/password sign-up form.
Fires when a user successfully signs in with email and password. Also used to identify the user.
Fires when a user clicks the sign out button from the user dropdown menu.
Fires when a user successfully submits a forgot-password form requesting a reset link.
Fires when a user successfully resets their password via the reset-password form.
Fires when a user successfully changes their account password from account settings.
Fires when a user successfully updates their display name from account settings.
Fires when a user successfully adds a new passkey from account settings.
Fires when a user successfully deletes a passkey from account settings.
Fires when a user revokes an active session from the account sessions settings.
Fires when a user successfully deletes their account. Critical churn event.
